articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially rolled out GPT-5 across ChatGPT and its API, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a vastly expanded context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains on ARC-AGI-2 and GPQA, with the model demonstrating more reliable chain-of-thought across multi-step scientific and engineering tasks. Enterprise API pricing introduced a new tiered compute model reflecting the variable cost of extended thinking.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Coding and Math Benchmarks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which claimed state-of-the-art results on SWE-Bench Verified, MATH-500, and several competitive programming benchmarks. The model introduces a mixture-of-experts architecture with adaptive compute allocation, allowing it to dynamically scale reasoning depth per query. Google also integrated the model into a revamped Codex-style agent within Google Cloud that can autonomously execute multi-file refactors.

articles.title: Anthropic Publishes Breakthrough Interpretability Results Mapping Claude's Internal Planning
articles.summary: Anthropic released a major research paper demonstrating circuit-level tracing of multi-step planning inside large language models, building on their prior work in mechanistic interpretability. Researchers identified specific feature circuits responsible for deceptive reasoning shortcuts and showed they could be surgically suppressed without degrading general capability. The work is being hailed as a significant step toward practical AI safety auditing tools for frontier models.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Demonstrates Autonomous Warehouse Operations at BMW Facility
articles.summary: Figure's second-generation humanoid robot completed a month-long pilot at a BMW logistics facility in South Carolina, autonomously performing bin picking, parts transport, and simple assembly assist tasks across full 8-hour shifts. The system leverages a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on factory-specific data, achieving a reported 94% task completion rate with minimal human intervention. BMW announced plans to expand the deployment to two additional plants by Q4 2026.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Achieves Real-Time Parkour Using Reinforcement Learning
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released footage and a technical blog post showing the electric Atlas performing dynamic parkour sequences—including running vaults and gap jumps—driven entirely by a sim-to-real reinforcement learning policy rather than pre-scripted trajectories. The approach uses a learned world model for predictive foot placement, achieving robust recovery from perturbations that would have caused failures in prior scripted systems. The milestone signals a shift toward fully learned locomotion for commercial humanoid platforms.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node for AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production has started on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Kaohsiung fab, with first customers including NVIDIA and Apple. The node delivers approximately 20% speed improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, leveraging gate-all-around nanosheet transistors with backside power delivery. The advance is critical for next-generation AI training chips projected to ship in early 2027.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins with First Compliance Audits of Frontier Model Providers
articles.summary: The European AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the EU AI Act's provisions for general-purpose AI models with systemic risk, targeting OpenAI, Google, and Meta's European operations. Auditors are examining model evaluation documentation, red-teaming reports, and compute reporting as required under the Act's transparency obligations. The enforcement action is being closely watched as a template for how algorithmic regulation will work in practice globally.

articles.title: Meta Releases Open-Source Llama 4 Behemoth with 2 Trillion Parameters
articles.summary: Meta publicly released the weights for Llama 4 Behemoth, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model offered under an updated open-source license permitting commercial use. The model matches or exceeds GPT-5 on several academic benchmarks while running on 8-GPU clusters via aggressive expert offloading and INT4 quantization. The release intensifies the open-weight versus closed-model debate, with Meta positioning open models as the default infrastructure layer for enterprise AI.
